review_evidence: Read the full 1679-line file: it defines FormalGroup.log (line 53), compInverse (line 141), compInverseOfUnit (line 770), FormalGroup.exp (line 893), LogPreservesAdd (line 998), and logHom (line 1671); proves log_coeff_zero/succ/one (lines 70-92), subst_compInverse_eq_X (line 681), pderiv_log (line 1165), logPreservesAdd (line 1590), and logHom_toSeries (line 1676); all are formal definitions, statements, and proofs in Lean.
summary: The file projects/HasseWeil/HasseWeil/FormalGroup/Logarithm.lean contains substantial formal mathematical content: definitions of formal logarithm (FormalGroup.log), compositional inverse (compInverse, compInverseOfUnit), formal exponential (FormalGroup.exp), and the LogPreservesAdd property; theorems with proofs including coefficient formulas (log_coeff_zero, log_coeff_succ, log_coeff_one), the compositional inverse identity (subst_compInverse_eq_X, subst_compInverseOfUnit_eq_X), Silverman IV.5.2 (logPreservesAdd with its derivative/chain-rule/uniqueness proof), and packaging as FormalGroupHom (logHom). Every declaration is a formal mathematical object with proof content relevant to the corpus. No exclusion is warranted.
